data_facts_with_para.paragraph: In the following six countries reporting more than 50 cases, 75% or more of the patients were homosexual males: the Netherlands (88%), the United Kingdom (87%), Denmark (86%), Sweden (81%), Norway (79%), and the Federal Republic of Germany (76%).

facts.fact_content: 88% of the patients were homosexual males in the Netherlands.
87% of the patients were homosexual males in the United Kingdom.
86% of the patients were homosexual males in Denmark.
81% of the patients were homosexual males in Sweden.
79% of the patients were homosexual males in Norway.
76% of the patients were homosexual males in the Federal Republic of Germany.
